component.name: Saikou
component.summary: Native anime client with AniList tracking

description.p: A native Linux client for Saikou. Browse and watch anime from community sources, with playback handled by mpv and your library synced to AniList or MyAnimeList.
Saikou does not host or distribute any content. It reads publicly available websites, exactly as a browser would.
The interface rebuilt from the desktop design, one-click AniList sign-in, and three anime sources that need no configuration.

ul.li: AniBD, KickAssAnime and AnimeHeaven work out of the box
Opening a title now finds the right one instead of the first search hit
Components animate on a shared clock rather than repainting
An AppImage is published alongside the Arch package

description.p: Phase 0: project scaffolding, core daemon, and RPC transport.
